map.制定学习计划、追踪任务进度、配合番茄钟提升专注力: Draw up a study plan, track task progress and pair it with a Pomodoro timer for better focus
map.累计专注时长 = 单次专注分钟数 × 完成轮数；当日目标达成 = 完成轮数 ÷: Cumulative focus time = minutes per focus session × rounds completed; today's goal met = rounds completed ÷ target rounds. The Pomodoro alternates focus and rest to help you sustain attention.
map.📚 深度解析：学习计划与番茄钟: 📚 In-depth: Study Plan and Pomodoro Timer
map.日常备考：把任务拆成清单，用番茄钟维持专注节奏: Daily preparation: break tasks into a checklist and keep a rhythm of focus with the Pomodoro
map.时间块规划：按科目与优先级排布每日学习时段: Time blocking: lay out each day's study slots by subject and priority
map.复盘统计：累计专注时长与完成轮数，调整计划: Review statistics: cumulative focus time and completed rounds help you adjust the plan
map.例：设定单次专注 25 分钟、休息 5 分钟、目标 8 轮；完成一轮即记一次专注: Example: set 25 minutes of focus, a 5-minute break and a target of 8 rounds; each completed round counts once, so the day's focus time is 25×8 = 200 minutes. Priorities can be marked in the task list so high-priority tasks move first.
map.番茄钟时长能改吗？: Can the Pomodoro length be changed?
map.可以，专注与休息时长、目标轮数都可自定义；常见组合是 25/5，深度任务可改为: Yes: the focus and break durations and the target number of rounds are all customizable. 25/5 is the usual pairing, deep work can use 50/10, the rule being not to interrupt your flow.
map.任务与统计保存在本机浏览器，清理缓存或更换设备不会同步；重要内容建议导出备份，避: Tasks and statistics are stored in this browser; clearing the cache or switching devices will not sync them. Export anything important so you do not lose your study plan.
